verdicts.reason: Both have the same serious flaw: the purple circle is cut off by a hard vertical edge at about x=408, leaving a strip of wood showing on the right. In the original the circle bleeds off the canvas edge, so this looks like a rendering error. Copy, hierarchy and the photo survive in both. A keeps the original spacing between the frame, the text and the dot column (about 28px from frame to dots, text indented about 105px). B pushes the dot column further right, leaving a 50px gap with the dots crowding the clipped edge, and shifts the text away from the original indent. That makes B slightly less faithful.
